sanitizers.precondition: any System with distance constraints between particles that are not both massless; any integrator that projects positions
sanitizers.invariant: after projection every constrained distance equals its target within the constraint tolerance
sanitizers.observation_point: after the position projection (CCMA and SETTLE)
sanitizers.alarm: relative distance error exceeds twice the tolerance plus 1e-12 plus 16*eps*|x|/d (coordinate spacing)
sanitizers.rationale: a rigid bond length that drifts changes the dynamics the constraint is meant to remove

sanitizers.invariant: after projection the relative velocity of each constrained pair along its bond is within the solver's stated tolerance
sanitizers.observation_point: after the velocity projection
sanitizers.alarm: |dv.e| exceeds twice tolerance*d*(1/m1+1/m2) plus rounding of the velocities
sanitizers.rationale: kinetic energy in a frozen degree of freedom distorts temperature and virial

sanitizers.precondition: any constrained System with finite masses
sanitizers.invariant: constraint forces are internal: the mass-weighted displacement they produce sums to zero
sanitizers.observation_point: after the position projection
sanitizers.alarm: norm of sum(m*dx) exceeds 1024*eps*N times the sum of m*(|dx|+|x|)
sanitizers.rationale: constraint forces must not add net linear momentum

sanitizers.invariant: an internal potential is translation invariant, so its forces sum to zero
sanitizers.observation_point: end of the kernel, force delta of this kernel only
sanitizers.alarm: norm of the summed force delta exceeds 1024*eps*N times the sum of |dF|+|F_before|+|F_after|
sanitizers.rationale: net force from an internal interaction would accelerate the system's center of mass

sanitizers.invariant: an internal potential is rotation invariant, so the net torque of its forces vanishes
sanitizers.observation_point: end of the kernel, force delta of this kernel only
sanitizers.alarm: norm of sum(r x dF) exceeds 1024*eps*N times the sum of |r|(|dF|+|F_before|+|F_after|)
sanitizers.rationale: net torque from an internal interaction would spin the system

sanitizers.precondition: NoCutoff or CutoffNonPeriodic, any parameters and exceptions
sanitizers.invariant: pairwise forces cancel, so the nonbonded forces sum to zero
sanitizers.observation_point: end of the kernel, force delta of this kernel only
sanitizers.alarm: norm of the summed force delta exceeds 1024*eps*N times the force scale (array magnitudes plus the magnitudes of the individual pair terms)
sanitizers.rationale: net force from pair interactions would accelerate the center of mass

sanitizers.invariant: central pair forces exert no net torque
sanitizers.observation_point: end of the kernel, force delta of this kernel only
sanitizers.alarm: norm of sum(r x dF) exceeds 1024*eps*N times the torque scale
sanitizers.rationale: net torque from pair interactions would spin the system

sanitizers.precondition: System with virtual sites, none a SymmetrySite, and every average / local-coordinates site having origin weights that sum to 1 (otherwise the site is not translation invariant)
sanitizers.invariant: a virtual site's position moves rigidly with its parents, so spreading its force conserves the total force
sanitizers.observation_point: after all virtual-site forces have been spread
sanitizers.alarm: total force on non-virtual particles differs from the total force before spreading beyond 1024*eps*N times the force scale
sanitizers.rationale: spreading must neither create nor destroy force

sanitizers.precondition: all virtual sites are two- or three-particle averages located at their weighted average position
sanitizers.invariant: spreading conserves the torque about the origin
sanitizers.observation_point: after all virtual-site forces have been spread
sanitizers.alarm: torque about the origin changes beyond 1024*eps*N times the torque scale
sanitizers.rationale: the force on an average site is a force at the weighted position of its parents

sanitizers.precondition: a CMMotionRemover with at least one massive particle
sanitizers.invariant: after removal the momentum of the massive particles vanishes
sanitizers.observation_point: end of the removal step
sanitizers.alarm: norm of sum(m*v) exceeds 1024*eps*N times the sum of m*|v| before and after the removal
sanitizers.rationale: the purpose of the remover is zero center-of-mass drift

sanitizers.precondition: particle whose mass in the integrator is zero and that is not a virtual site
sanitizers.invariant: an integration step does not move it
sanitizers.observation_point: after dynamics->update
sanitizers.alarm: its position changes
sanitizers.rationale: zero-mass particles are fixed by convention; moving them corrupts reference frames

sanitizers.invariant: a volume move translates each molecule rigidly, so all its internal distances are unchanged
sanitizers.observation_point: after the coordinate scaling
sanitizers.alarm: any intramolecular distance changes beyond 256*eps times the coordinate scale
sanitizers.rationale: a barostat must not deform molecules

sanitizers.invariant: the box volume after the move equals the proposed volume used in the acceptance rule
sanitizers.observation_point: after the box and coordinates are scaled
sanitizers.alarm: det(box) differs from the proposed volume by more than 64*eps*V
sanitizers.rationale: the acceptance rule is only valid for the volume that was actually reached

sanitizers.precondition: isotropic Monte Carlo barostat, geometric center of each independently scaled unit
sanitizers.invariant: a volume move is an affine map: fractional coordinates of the units in the box do not change
sanitizers.observation_point: after the box and coordinates are scaled
sanitizers.alarm: fractional shift of a unit center exceeds 1024*eps*N times factors for distance from the origin in box units and box tilt
sanitizers.rationale: coordinates and box must be scaled by the same factor

sanitizers.invariant: molecules partition the particles; constraints, virtual-site dependences and harmonic bonds never cross molecules
sanitizers.observation_point: after the molecules are determined
sanitizers.alarm: a particle is missing or repeated, or a bonded pair lies in different molecules
sanitizers.rationale: rigid-molecule barostats and molecular kinetic energy rely on it

sanitizers.precondition: automatically chosen alpha, error tolerance in [1e-10, 1e-1]
sanitizers.invariant: the real-space sum truncated at the cutoff has relative error at most the requested tolerance
sanitizers.observation_point: after alpha is chosen
sanitizers.alarm: erfc(alpha*cutoff) exceeds the tolerance
sanitizers.rationale: the user's accuracy request must be honoured

sanitizers.precondition: automatically chosen kmax, error tolerance in [1e-10, 1e-1]
sanitizers.invariant: the Gaussian decay exp(-(pi*kmax/(alpha*L))^2) at the last wave vector is within a factor 100 of the tolerance
sanitizers.observation_point: after kmax is chosen
sanitizers.alarm: decay exceeds 100*tolerance in any dimension
sanitizers.rationale: the reciprocal sum must be converged to the requested accuracy

sanitizers.precondition: periodic cutoff method, at most 100 particles, with or without switching function (width at least 3% of the cutoff)
sanitizers.invariant: the coefficient equals the integrated Lennard-Jones tail beyond the cutoff (plus the part removed by the switch) averaged over all particle pairs
sanitizers.observation_point: return value
sanitizers.alarm: relative disagreement with a composite Simpson quadrature (log r in the switched region) exceeds 1e-6 of the summed repulsive and attractive tail magnitudes
sanitizers.rationale: an independent route to the same physical integral

sanitizers.invariant: the shifted potential 1/r + krf*r^2 - crf vanishes at the cutoff
sanitizers.observation_point: after krf and crf are set
sanitizers.alarm: magnitude exceeds 16*eps/cutoff
sanitizers.rationale: the reaction-field energy must be continuous at the cutoff

sanitizers.invariant: the switch is within [0, 1] and does not increase with distance
sanitizers.observation_point: after the switch value and derivative are computed
sanitizers.alarm: value outside [0, 1] or positive derivative (beyond 16*eps)
sanitizers.rationale: a switch that amplifies or grows with r changes the potential's sign and sets

sanitizers.precondition: at most 400 particles; periodic cells whose perpendicular widths are at least twice the cutoff
sanitizers.invariant: every non-excluded pair closer than the cutoff under the minimum image convention is in the neighbor list
sanitizers.observation_point: after the neighbor list is built
sanitizers.alarm: a pair closer than cutoff*(1-1e-9) (found by scanning lattice translations) is missing
sanitizers.rationale: missing pairs silently remove interactions from energies and forces

sanitizers.precondition: chains of single (non-paired) massive particles that do not overlap
sanitizers.invariant: total DOF = 3 per massive thermostated particle - 1 per constraint between two massive thermostated particles - 3 if a CMMotionRemover is present
sanitizers.observation_point: after the CM-removal adjustment
sanitizers.alarm: sum of chain DOF differs from the independently counted value
sanitizers.rationale: the thermostat temperature is only correct for the true number of kinetic degrees of freedom

sanitizers.precondition: any continuous tabulated function (the last node of a periodic dimension is identified with the first and not checked)
sanitizers.invariant: the spline reproduces the stored value at every grid node (node positions recomputed from min, max, count)
sanitizers.observation_point: end of the constructor
sanitizers.alarm: value differs from the stored one by more than 1000*eps*max|value| (the last node is the upper limit itself)
sanitizers.rationale: an interpolating table must return its data

sanitizers.invariant: every patch reproduces the map energy at its four corners and neighboring patches agree along shared edges, including wrap-around
sanitizers.observation_point: end of the coefficient computation
sanitizers.alarm: corner or edge mismatch exceeding 1e-9 of the largest map energy
sanitizers.rationale: a discontinuous energy surface produces force spikes

sanitizers.invariant: descreening by neighbors can only push the effective Born radius outward from the offset intrinsic radius, and it is finite
sanitizers.observation_point: after each Born radius is computed
sanitizers.alarm: radius below the offset radius (beyond 64*eps) or non-finite
sanitizers.rationale: a Born radius smaller than the atom's own radius is unphysical

sanitizers.precondition: ConstantPotentialForce with the charge constraint enabled
sanitizers.invariant: after solving the electrode charges sum to the requested total
sanitizers.observation_point: after the charge solve
sanitizers.alarm: sum of electrode charges differs from the target by more than 1000*eps*sum|q|
sanitizers.rationale: the constraint defines the total charge of the electrodes

sanitizers.invariant: at exit the gradient of the energy with respect to electrode charges (projected onto the constraint plane when active) is within the requested tolerance
sanitizers.observation_point: after the charge solve (gradient recomputed independently)
sanitizers.alarm: squared projected residual exceeds 4*tol^2*N plus a rounding floor from the zero-charge potentials
sanitizers.rationale: the charges must satisfy the constant-potential condition to the requested accuracy

sanitizers.precondition: System without distance constraints (the objective is then the potential energy)
sanitizers.invariant: a line-search minimizer does not end above its starting energy, and the Context holds the point lbfgs returns
sanitizers.observation_point: after lbfgs returns
sanitizers.alarm: final energy exceeds the first evaluated energy by more than 64*eps*(|e0|+|e1|), or the positions in the Context differ from the returned minimum
sanitizers.rationale: minimization must not make the energy worse
